data: Which of the following types of words has the highest accuracy score in layer 1?

The caption mentions that the figure shows POS-based classification accuracy on states from the ENDE encoder + lexical shortcuts. The figure is organized with different layers (layer 1 through layer 6) and different types of words (NOUNS, VERBS, ADJ/ADV, OTHER). Each cell represents the accuracy score for a specific type of word in a particular layer.

From the data:

- Comparing these values, OTHER has the highest accuracy score at 0.999.

Therefore, the type of word with the highest accuracy score in layer 1 is OTHER.
